title: Amazon CloudWatch Omni: AI-first observability for agents and applications
description_plain: AWS announces the general availability of Amazon CloudWatch Omni, an evolution of Amazon CloudWatch. Omni is an AI-powered observability experience organized around your teams and the applications they run.

title: OpenAI GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna are now generally available on Amazon Bedrock
description_plain: Today, AWS announces the general availability of GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna from OpenAI on Amazon Bedrock. These models give teams more ways to balance intelligence and cost.

title: Claude Opus 5.5 is now available on AWS
description_plain: AWS now offers Claude Opus 5.5, Anthropic's most capable Opus model yet, a better collaborator that handles long-running coding and knowledge work.

title: Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base adds ACL debug APIs
description_plain: Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base now provides CheckIngestedDocumentAcl and GetIngestedDocumentAcl APIs to help debug access control issues in RAG systems.

title: Amazon EMR introduces Long Term Support with Apache Spark 4.1
description_plain: Amazon EMR introduces Long Term Support (LTS) releases, starting with emr-spark-8.1.0 and Apache Spark 4.1. Designated versions receive 36 months of support.

title: Amazon EMR 7.14 is now available
description_plain: Amazon EMR 7.14 is now available with new features across Amazon EMR on EC2, Amazon EMR on EKS, and Amazon EMR Serverless.

title: AWS Glue Data Quality delivers context-specific rule recommendations in seconds
description_plain: AWS Glue Data Quality now generates data quality rules in seconds, reducing the time to establish data quality checks for your tables in the AWS Glue Data Catalog.

title: Amazon ECS now provides real-time deployment observability in the AWS Management Console
description_plain: Amazon ECS now provides real-time service deployment observability for native Linear, Canary, and Blue/Green deployment strategies.

title: Amazon ECS Express Mode now supports AWS Graviton (ARM64) workloads
description_plain: Amazon ECS Express Mode now supports specifying ARM64 as the CPU architecture, making it easy to deploy ARM-based container images on AWS Graviton-powered compute.

title: AWS Lambda extends function timeout to 90 minutes on Lambda Managed Instances
description_plain: AWS Lambda now supports function timeouts up to 90 minutes on Lambda Managed Instances, enabling long-running workloads like media transcoding and batch processing.

title: AWS Lambda now supports Graviton5-powered EC2 instances on Lambda Managed Instances
description_plain: AWS Lambda Managed Instances now supports Graviton5-based instance types, delivering up to 25% better compute performance compared to Graviton4.

title: AWS Security Hub AI Inventory adds Azure self-hosted instance support
description_plain: AWS Security Hub AI Inventory now supports discovering and cataloging AI assets running on self-hosted instances in Microsoft Azure.
